motion.name: Motion
motion.hint: How much the Wings of Freedom sheets move: Full, Reduced (fades only), or Off. Your system's reduced-motion preference caps Full at Reduced. Only you see this.
motion.fullHint: Sheets settle, jolt, and flash; the gas and blade widgets animate.
motion.reducedHint: Short fades and colour only. Nothing slides or shakes.
motion.offHint: No movement. The gas and blade widgets are drawn still.
motion.menuHint: How much the sheets move. Only you see this.
motion.osReduced: Your system asks for reduced motion, so Full plays as Reduced.

gore.name: Gore
gore.hint: How wounds are drawn on the soldier figure: Low (clinical hatching), Standard, or Graphic. Only you see this.
gore.lowHint: Wounds as clinical hatching and dashed outlines. No blood.
gore.standardHint: Muted blood and cuts. No spatter or bone.
gore.graphicHint: Spatter, pooled blood, and bone; blood drips when Motion is Full.
gore.menuHint: How wounds show on the inked soldier and Titan. Only you see this.

stress.name: Auto-apply: Stress
stress.hint: Roll cards change Stress themselves: a Push, a Cover, a Stress Response, a Fear result, and a failed called roll staked on Stress. Off: the card lists the change with an Apply button.

wear.name: Auto-apply: gear wear
wear.hint: A Pushed roll’s Gear Dice showing 1 wear the gear item (a Blade Set is ruined), with any wear-ignoring Talent used. Off: the card lists the wear with an Apply button.

stressResponse.name: Auto-apply: Stress Responses
stressResponse.hint: A lasting Stress Response rolled on a card is recorded on the soldier. Off: the card lists it with an Apply button.

gas.name: Auto-apply: Gas Rating
gas.hint: A Gas Roll lowers the Gas Rating, and a Pushed ODM Gear roll marks the round’s Gas Roll as three dice. Off: the card lists the change with an Apply button.

fear.name: Auto-apply: Fear results and penalties
fear.hint: A Fear result’s next-roll penalty and forced move or strike are recorded, a used next-roll penalty is cleared, and a Drive shrug-off is marked. Off: the card lists them with an Apply button.

end.regenFull: {label}: the clock fills. Openings erased, counts cleared.
end.stands: {label} stands. The soldiers it pinned are freed.
end.stopped: A retreat is under way: no clock fills.
end.retreatBegins: The Titan Engagement becomes a retreat.
end.roundEnds: Unspent moves and actions are lost.
end.foesGone: Every Foe is gone: the Skirmish ends.
end.noneStanding: No soldier stands: the Skirmish ends.
end.mayLeave: The players may declare that the Squad leaves.
end.momentumLost: No ODM move this round, so all Momentum is lost: {who}.
end.wreckIgnored: One good tree survives: the first Anchor is not lost.
end.momentumTrim: {name} is over the new cap and holds {n}.

note.startTitan: Anchor Rating {anchor}. Focus Titan A: {titan}. Everyone holds Distant.
note.noWings: No Squadmate is on a Wing.
note.retreatForced: Retreat: every standing soldier must move, toward Distant and out, or toward a fallen comrade while the stay limit allows. Other moves are refused.
note.holding: Holds {name}: no behavior, the ladder is not read, the Next Behavior is kept.
note.decoyCard: The decoy ({decoy}) holds its Attention: no behavior, {left} cards left. The Next Behavior is spent.
note.liftedLine: The first counted turn ends: the Grab spent its action.
note.corpseHeatLine: A Burn Critical Injury at the pinned location, at the start of this turn.
note.enterNoActor: {name}'s clock is full, but no Titan actor was found to bring in.
note.fallBack: Fall Back: {name} holds In Reach of {label}
note.thrash: {name}: it falls back on its Thrash.
note.behaviorWaits: Its behavior is dealt to the GM, waiting to be rolled.
note.flightLoud: They come in loud: {label} hears them.
note.carry: Carry: {n} Momentum spent on the extra steps.
note.chargeDouble: A charge in and out again on the plain: {label} hears them, and they end where they began.

death.fall: In the falling body's path, Leap Clear from the sheet or be Pinned: {who}.
death.ends: No Focus Titan is alive and no one is Pinned: the Titan Engagement ends.

grab.freed: {name} is freed and holds In Reach.
grab.freedFalls: {name} is freed and falls, then holds In Reach.

ending.notMet: No ending test is met yet.
ending.byNoFocus: No Focus Titan is alive and no soldier is Pinned.
ending.byNoStanding: No soldier who holds a Position is standing.
ending.title: The Titan Engagement ends
ending.steps: The end steps follow on the board, in order.
ending.closed: The engagement is closed. Positions are cleared.

pick.close-in: Closes in on {target} and fights with the {weapon}

result.ignored: The tracker ignored a card from {name}: {why}
result.decoy: The decoy ({decoy}) holds its Attention for {n} cards (needed {need}).
result.horseBolts: The horse bolts and leaves the Titan Engagement.
result.flare: The flare fills every Background clock by 1.
result.whiff: The card whiffs against every target.
result.noArm: No arm can hold: the Grab does nothing.
result.grabbed: {name} is Grabbed and held On Body by {label}.
result.pinnedCrush: {name} is Pinned: only the crush lands.
result.injuryMissing: The Critical Injury entry is missing from the compendium.
result.noGuard: No Guard: the Ambush leaves it unanswered.
result.firstKill: {name} has killed a person for the first time: a Fear Roll.
result.groupBreaks: The group reaches its Grit and breaks.

board.title: Engagement board
board.folio: Soldier by Focus Titan, Anchor Rating {anchor}
board.matrixHint: Pick a cell to change a Position
board.engagedHint: Each pair apart; pick to close in or break away
board.onWing: On the Wing of {name}: no card
board.grabbedCell: Grabbed: holds On Body toward {label} until freed
board.key: Letters: D Distant, I In Reach, O On Body, B Blind Spot, coloured by Titan
board.closeRule: On Body or Blind Spot toward one Titan turns the other's On Body or Blind Spot into In Reach. A Grabbed soldier holds On Body toward the Titan holding them.
board.skirmishNote: No Wings in a Skirmish: Squadmates act on their own cards. No swap step. The Foe group takes one card and its Foes act in label order.
board.setNextHint: The GM’s override: the entry this Titan’s next card resolves. A dot marks an entry whose Body Parts it lacks.
board.openingBy: Made by {name}, who cannot spend it
board.bgNote: Full with two Focus Titans alive: retreat
board.retreatNote: Full: the Titan Engagement becomes a retreat
board.foeFolio: One Foe group, no Titan takes part
board.foeHint: Guard and Attack Dice are never adjusted
board.noClocks: A Skirmish carries no Background clock and no retreat clock. It ends when the Foes are gone, the Squad leaves, or no soldier stands.
board.manual: The table resolves this step; stamp it when done.

setup.noTitans: Place a Titan token on the scene first.
setup.noSoldiers: Place the soldiers' tokens on the scene first.
setup.noFoes: Place the Foe tokens on the scene first.
setup.nightHint: At night: a Bandit's club is a firebrand.
setup.footTitan: Everyone starts at Distant. Round 1 begins at its Wings step.
setup.footSkirmish: Everyone starts Apart. Round 1 begins at its deal.

close.aftermath: Aftermath rolls for: {list}. Roll Treat Injury from the sheet.
close.deathRolls: Death Rolls for: {list}. Roll them from the sheet; these deaths cause no Fear Roll.
close.care: Hold the care window: treat from the sheets.
close.retire: Retiring with five Scars: {who}. A soldier who lost both arms or both legs retires too.
close.promotion: Share out left items and dropped Blade Sets, then promote replacements for the dead and retired.

swapBlades.down: A Down soldier cannot fit a Blade Set.
swapBlades.handlesFull: The handles already hold a Blade Set.
swapBlades.noBlades: The soldier carries no Blade Set to fit.
swapBlades.grabbed: A Grabbed soldier cannot fit a Blade Set.
swapBlades.moveSpent: Fitting a Blade Set spends the move, and this turn’s move is gone.

TerrainTrait.mounted-break-attention: A mounted soldier’s Break Attention gains 1 Bonus Die.
TerrainTrait.first-wreck-ignored: The first Anchor wrecked here is not lost.
TerrainTrait.blind-spot-anchored: A soldier at Blind Spot is anchored to a roof and is not airborne, so a Jam does not drop them.
TerrainTrait.first-carry-free: The first step a Flight carries costs no Momentum.

MomentumSpend.carry: Carry: one more Position step on this move.
MomentumSpend.bite: Bite: 1 Bonus Die on a strike or Break Attention this turn, against the Titan you flew toward.
MomentumSpend.brace: Brace: 1 Bonus Die on your next dodge this round.
MomentumSpend.quiet: Quiet: nothing you do this turn marks you loudest.
MomentumSpend.clean-line: Clean line: you make no Gas Roll this round.
